architecture.scope: Early kernel substrate with explicit boot, memory, runtime and architecture boundaries; current target evidence is limited to documented bring-up profiles.
architecture.runtime_boundary: Kernel image, host tests and platform-specific targets are separate build products.
architecture.composition_rule: Compose only freestanding-compatible objects for a named architecture and linker profile; keep bootloader, launcher and kernel contracts explicit.

components.responsibility: Versioned boot information and handoff validation.
Early x86_64 kernel entry and serial diagnostics.
Host-testable runtime contracts and bounded state.
Research and host-side platform boundary for E2K.

dependencies.relationship: image format and pre-handoff contract reference

preserved_boundaries: Bootloader handoff, image admission and kernel execution are distinct phases.
Host tests do not prove bootability or physical hardware compatibility.
Architecture-specific entry, linker and interrupt code stays isolated by target.
forbidden_composition: No loading host Python or Swift runtime into the freestanding kernel.
No claim of a complete operating system based on early kernel bring-up.
No E2K capability claims without target toolchain and hardware evidence.
gaps: Capture reproducible QEMU boot logs and compiler/linker hashes.
Treat physical E2K boot and qualification as pending until independently observed.
